The *Maṅgalajātaka* (Ja 87), translated as *Omens*, belongs to the canonical Jātaka collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. According to the narrative framework preserved in the tradition, the story opens with the verse incipit rendered in English as "Whoso renounces". The Buddha is recounted as having delivered the tale while residing at the Bamboo Grove (Veḷuvana), directing it towards a brahmin reputed for making prognostications based on pieces of cloth.
